About Notabene
Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: 
US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have
Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.
The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if
• 
Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests
• 
The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time
• 
Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration
• 
Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported
• 
Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact
• 
Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced
• 
At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing
Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.
Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.
Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.
Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.
Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.
Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.
Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.
Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.
Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.
External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring
• 
Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists
• 
You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it
• 
Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies
• 
Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor
• 
You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger
• 
Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have
• 
Active CPA license
• 
Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar
• 
Public accounting background, especially audit
• 
Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable
• 
Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual
• 
Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure
• 
Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure

Benefits
Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!
If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you're returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.
Notabene is proud to be an equal employment workplace and an affirmative action employer. By valuing inclusion and diversity of all forms, we strictly prohibit and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation.

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
About the role
As our Field Marketing Manager for Healthcare / SLED, you will be the primary growth engine and lead marketing architect for Healthcare and State, Local & Education (SLED) — responsible for pulling together people and resources to build a full GTM marketing motion that lands and expands some of the company’s largest, most critical named accounts in these verticals.
This role sits in the Public Sector organization. You’ll help support Public Sector overall, with a clear focus on Healthcare and SLED, and you’ll collaborate across adjacent verticals where motions overlap (including Life Sciences events).
We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-minded marketing strategist who can alternate between strategic pipeline and account planning with vertical sales and flawless execution of industry experiences for customer executives. If you are obsessed with driving pipeline from high-touch, standout programs and are a self-starter who thrives at the intersection of technical innovation, healthcare / public-sector narrative, and enterprise GTM, we want you.
This is a remote role with travel for industry programs and customer engagements.
What You’ll Do
Pipeline Architecture & Vertical Ownership
• 
Own the Healthcare / SLED GTM: Build and execute a data-driven marketing plan for Healthcare and SLED, and orchestrate core business partners into one motion aimed at must-win accounts.
• 
Master the Land & Expand: Own the vertical pipeline target. Design and run the programs that help priority accounts land, expand, and adopt more of the platform, focused where the commercial opportunity is highest.
• 
Creative Agility: Fearlessly think outside the standard playbook to deploy memorable in-person, virtual, and next-gen experiences — and the operational workflows that bring them to life.
• 
Industry Narrative: Translate the Cursor (now part of SpaceXAI) mission into healthcare and SLED language — the problems these buyers already feel (clinical / payer / provider / state & education IT), the outcomes they are measured on, and why this platform is the answer. Partner with PMM and corporate marketing so the story stays sharp, consistent, and specific enough that a CIO, CMIO, or public-sector technology leader hears their world, not a generic AI pitch.
• 
Sales Partner: Act as the strategic marketing partner to Healthcare and SLED sales. Lead planning calls, provide account-level insights, analyze vertical pipeline trends, lock alignment on priority accounts, and maximize the impact of every motion. Know what you run as Vertical vs what you plug into Enterprise Field formats. Support broader Public Sector needs as needed.
Measurement & Operational Excellence
• 
Event Orchestration: Obsess over the end-to-end details of every program — ideation, promotion, vendor management, onsite, and follow-up — going beyond day-of execution.
• 
Data-Driven Iteration: Track every dollar spent against pipeline generated. Manage your vertical budget toward high-impact investments on critical accounts.
• 
Feedback Loop: Serve as the eyes and ears of Healthcare and SLED. Feed Corporate and PMM real-time feedback on messaging resonance and competitive shifts.
Your DNA
• 
The Healthcare Vertical Owner: You assemble Sales, PMM, Enterprise Field, FE/Solutions, and CS/ADM into one motion aimed at pipeline on the company’s largest accounts, not just events. 5–7+ years of healthcare marketing / GTM experience is required (provider, payer, health systems, health tech, or adjacent). You know how to sell into healthcare buying centers and can partner credibly with sales on complex, regulated accounts.
• 
The Revenue Mindset: You care about pipeline and closed-won, not leads. You speak sales and will be held to a number.
• 
The Gritty Optimizer: A self-starter who can build a program from a blank page and tighten it with the data.
• 
Exceptional Communicator: Sharp and persuasive, whether it’s a personal invite to a CIO / CMIO or a QBR for leadership.
Technical & Tactical Toolkit
• 
Field Presence: Ability to travel (~30%) to host industry programs, support Vertical Sales, and connect with customers in-market.
• 
Event Craft: Experience producing high-end, white-glove executive experiences — including industry-flagship overlays (e.g. HIMSS / CHIME / HLTH-class motions) and 1:few vertical ABM — that stand out in a crowded market.

Headquarters: Portugal - Remote

Be Part of Building the Future

Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.  Learn more at www.dremio.com.
About the role

In this role you will get opportunities to implement and maintain CI/CD systems and developer productivity solutions. You will be responsible for both regularly scheduled work as well as on-demand break-fix work to support Dremio’s CI/CD system, identifying areas of improvement, and implementing changes to increase efficiency and effectiveness of those systems.

Bring your industry experience to improve the efficiency and scale of Dremio’s infrastructure via innovation on tooling and methodologies. You should have empathy for developers and a passion for engineering productivity. 

What you’ll be doing

• Solve problems for fellow Dremio engineers by:

• Leveraging and contributing to playbooks to implement solutions to unblock them

• Identifying short term workarounds and documenting them

• Automating processes where manual processes exist.

• Working on infrastructure across all major clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).

• Managing access to key infrastructure.

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and associated systems to increase organizational efficiency.

• Automate local development workflows.

• Analyze performance bottlenecks, root cause issues, file defects, follow up with developers, and document resolutions.

• Clear focus on keeping our development branches ‘green’. 

• Release engineering - automating processes to push software to delivery endpoints.

• Report out on the status, reliability and robustness of our CI/CD systems.

• Actively participate in code reviews. 

What we’re looking for

• B.S. or M.S in Computer Science or in a related technical field

• 1+ years of experience on large scale distributed systems

• Comfortable navigating the fast moving, unstructured nature of a hyper-growth startup.

• Demonstrable Knowledge and Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP)

• Basic understanding of cloud networking and cloud architecture.

• Proficiency in any of Java/C++/Python/Go

• Knowledge of Maven or similar build environments

• Hands on experience in pipeline automation using CI/CD tools like Jenkins 

• Experience in Infrastructure as Code

• Experience with Terraform, BASH, Docker, Jenkins, and Kubernetes

• Ability to write technical reports, effectively summarizing key data

• Passion for learning and then delivering solutions using latest technologies

• Strong Affinity for collaboration and teamwork

 Bonus points if you have

• Working knowledge in data lakes and data warehousing

• Proficient with SQL

What we value 

At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.

Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.

Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click here to review the privacy notice. 

Important Security Notice for Candidates

At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement here.

Dremio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

About the role:
If you’re passionate about pushing the limits of reliability, fault-tolerance, and operational excellence in complex distributed systems, Camunda offers the perfect stage.
As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend, you’ll take ownership of automated reliability testing and chaos engineering at the core of Camunda 8. This role thrives on curiosity, experimentation, and relentless improvement—you’ll break things (on purpose!) in safe environments to strengthen our platform before customers ever feel the impact. Here, you’ll make a measurable impact and guide product direction, all while learning new technologies and collaborating with talented, friendly colleagues who live our FAITH values (Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent, and Humor).
Every day at Camunda, you’ll help us build robust systems, empower teams, and deliver a great user experience—even in failure scenarios.
Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

• 
 Design, implement, and execute automated chaos experiments and reliability tests, validating Camunda's platform under real-world scenarios
• 
You will investigate, root-cause and debug potential failures or performance regressions of our Java based products
• 
Continuously improve existing load testing, chaos engineering and observability infrastructure to keep our system reliable and performant
• 
Here we use different languages, tools and frameworks like java, go, kubernetes, prometheus, grafana, etc.
• 
As an example of the above you can check out this CamundaCon recording or this blog post
• 
Introduce new tooling and approaches for reliability testing, driving measurable improvements to operational experience and user outcomes (examples from the past: introducing zbchaos as fault injection tool)
• 
Collaborate closely with QA and engineering (including cross-functional teams), sharing learnings (e.g. with our team blog) and influencing team roadmaps based on experiment findings
• 
Champion a pragmatic, autonomous approach to software design, solving tough problems and learning new principles and technologies (Kubernetes, Helm, Grafana, Java, Go, and more)
• 
Advocate for user-centric reliability by using and understanding Camunda’s products firsthand

Defining success for this role:
• 
Based on all of the above, you have end to end delivered a concrete task, as for example (the concrete goal will be defined during your onboarding):
• 
After 3 months, you have designed and delivered a way to run quick and reproducible load tests, allowing us:
• 
to reduce the feedback loops for engineers
• 
directly fitting into the development lifecycle
• 
Enable engineers to make use of it and extend it
• 
After 3 months, you have designed and implemented a realistic, automated, holistic load testing framework for Optimize, in close collaboration with Senior Engineers and Field teams:
• 
Conducted a deep-dive analysis of performance limits.
• 
Shared results with the relevant core engineering teams and enabled them to re-run the tests.
Documented findings in public-facing documentation to help users better understand performance characteristics and guide their installation design.

What You Bring:
• 
Ability and/or willingness to use our product
• 
5+ years of experience in backend software engineering (Java)
• 
Proven drive to experiment, learn new tech, and conduct automated reliability and chaos testing in distributed environments
• 
Deep enthusiasm for improving performance and fault-tolerance in production systems
• 
Autonomous, pragmatic problem-solving skills with an ability to guide and influence others
• 
Willingness and ability to use Camunda products and approach reliability from a user’s perspective

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. About the role

Hi, my name is Eric Anderson, Senior Controller at Customer.io, and I'm looking for an AP Contractor to keep our T&E engine running clean through a busy stretch. Our Accounting team relies on Ramp and Navan to keep expense and travel spend moving, and we need someone who can own the day-to-day grind — coding, reconciling, chasing exceptions — without losing sight of the bigger picture. This is a 6-month contract with real ownership from day one, working closely with Terre Holmes and the AP team.

What we value

• Ownership — you drive the exception queue to zero, not someone else.

• Directness — you enforce policy clearly and kindly, without dodging hard conversations.

• Precision — a mismatched dollar amount doesn't get past you.

What you’ll do

• Own Ramp expense management end-to-end — review, code, and approve expense reports, chase missing receipts, and enforce policy compliance.

• Administer Navan travel — reconcile bookings and spend, flag policy exceptions, and support employees through out-of-policy approvals.

• Review AP bills for accuracy, coding, and approval routing — catching duplicate invoices and mismatched amounts before they hit the payment queue.

• Reconcile Ramp and Navan activity against the GL and drive the exception queue to zero before every close.

• Serve as the responsive point of contact for vendors — confirming payment details, tracking status, and resolving disputes.

• Spot recurring T&E headaches and propose (and document) process fixes.

What we're looking for

• 3+ years of AP & T&E experience, ideally in SaaS or a high-growth environment

• Hands-on experience with Ramp and/or Navan (or comparable — Concur, Expensify, TravelPerk)

• Sharp eye for detail and a solid grasp of expense policy enforcement

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to manage a recurring, deadline-driven workload

• Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP is a plus

Compensation & Benefits

This is a contracted engagement at $45–60/hr USD, depending on experience, for an estimated 6-month term.

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• 30-minute video call with a Recruiter

• 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager

• 45-minute cross-functional screen with a member of the AP team

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now.

About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
